svg.title: World religious composition, 2020-2100
svg.text: Share of world population. Reference scenario (stabilising): mean of 40 runs, the 5-95% spread of the runs, and the 90% predictive interval. Grey line: the range of all 8 scenario means.

The run spread is parameter uncertainty. The predictive interval adds the forecast errors the model made on World Religion Project 1970-2010 and Pew 2010-2020 (resampled by decade, scaled by horizon; religion_forecast/errors.py),

which covered 78-88% of held-out observed shares at nominal 90% (horizons 10-40 years, no calendar overlap with the error model). Both are conditional on WPP 2024 national demography. Each panel has its own scale.
